intro: This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Portsmouth across {areaCount} areas: Guildhall Walk, Port Solent and Fratton. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. This guide helps you choose a pub, understand how local pricing works and plan around breakfast or club days. pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Portsmouth are set pub by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Any prices used for comparison should be treated as typical, not fixed across all locations.

Location matters when comparing costs: city centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs. That general pattern does not establish which Portsmouth branch is cheapest, and the supplied information does not explain the reasons for individual price differences.

For an exact current price, check the menu at your chosen pub or ask at the bar before ordering. If using the Wetherspoon app, select the intended pub and check the amount shown before submitting your order. Compare the same dish across branches for a useful comparison.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight in the morning until noon, but Portsmouth visitors should confirm the schedule with their chosen pub. These are typical [breakfast](/breakfast-menu) service times, not a statement of each branch’s opening hours. Traditional breakfast is among the popular dishes on the national menu.

[Curry Club](/curry-club) is traditionally on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. Check participation, current dishes and typical prices before planning a visit around either club. For a straightforward choice outside those plans, the national menu also includes burgers, curries, fish and chips and pizza.
